verdict.rationale: Consensus offers literature-review features (search, screen, extract, synthesize) with study-design/PICO extraction, filters by study type, and library import at scale, which support a systematic screening/extraction workflow. However, there is no evidence of consistent, auditable screening criteria (e.g., inclusion/exclusion rule configuration, PRISMA-style tracking, reviewer agreement) or exportable extraction tables across large batches — missing for 10: documented criteria-based screening controls, systematic review protocol support (e.g., PRISMA), and independent validation of consistency across large paper sets.
